checked.claim: Room Setup's Apply writes back every column of a row whose room the world changed since the open, undoing a forced lock and deleting a Repair the Lock under way
checked.why: Read the whole road. readRoomSetupForm reads every row off the form as drawn; applyRoomRows compares each row with the flags read at Apply time (before, wasLocked, wasBroken), so a row the GM never touched is not `same` once the world changed it. With wasBroken true (forceDoor set it while open) and the drawn box false, setRoomBroken(false) and dropLockRepairs run; setVaultRoom then writes the drawn owner, table, description and picture, and writeRoomLock the drawn lock if the lock moved. The window's only redraw is keepFresh on the search-token setting (recountTokenCells writes token fields alone) and the Passages box's own keepFresh; no Hooks.on, keepLive or updateRegion listener in room-setup.mjs, and no other file finds the window by its class (grep of drpg-window-rooms: room-setup.mjs only). A Repair the Lock can only start after the break (repairLockRefusal needs roomBroken), so the scenario's order is a real one. E74-T5 sets the break and the lock before calling openRoomSetupDialog, so it pins the mend by hand only. The window's own comment (1343-1348) puts it open during Daily Life, so the change in between is ordinary; major holds.

checked.claim: A room's actions saved before the room is marked are written to its pieces but read back as none: count 0, editor reopens empty
checked.why: The Edit button is enabled on `possible` (pieces that can be a room, marked or not). setRoomActions writes on writablePieces (canBeRoom, no mark needed); roomActions reads through roomFlag -> roomRegions -> roomPieces, which filters on isRoomWith, which requires the ROOM_FLAG true. On an undecided region the two differ exactly as the finding says, and the opener rereads the count through roomActions after Save. The editor itself opens with roomActions(scene, room), so it reopens empty and its next Save replaces the first list. Undecided regions are every room of a new map before the first Apply, an ordinary setup step; minor holds (nothing is lost once Apply marks the room, unless the GM saved a second time).
